files.description: Canonical convention document for this repo — tech decisions, coding standards, testing and commit conventions. The source of truth a rule should be checked against before it is enforced.
Why the manifest's layers.*.ports / adapters lists are a curated ownership registry rather than a file inventory: accuracy is the invariant, completeness is not.
Port direction. A contract implemented by an infrastructure adapter, or injected into a use case as a dependency, is outbound (ports/out); a contract a use case itself implements is inbound.
Test runner and assertion policy. §2 permits expect(); §3 makes the choice per file; assert.* is retained codebase-wide and is not legacy.
Arch-lint enforcement posture: the ratchet baseline shrinks and never grows, and the domain npm-package allowlist is deliberately short and justified per entry.
The @internal ACL over @hexagen/local-llm. Explains why a local-llm restriction is repeated inside narrowly-scoped ESLint blocks rather than being duplication.
The published contract of @hexagen-monaco/sync is the hexagen binary; the root barrel is provisional under 0.x and removals ride a minor, never a patch.
